annotations.title: Create, change or end a subscription offer

description: Creates an offer on one subscription (leave offerId out), or changes or ends one (offerId from ploa_offers_get), straight to the store (needs a token allowed to submit). End one with values { state: "ended" }; put a Google Play draft or ended offer on sale with { state: "active" }. App Store values: type (intro, promotional, winback, code), mode (free, pay_as_you_go, pay_up_front), duration (P3D P1W P2W P1M P2M P3M P6M P1Y; for pay_as_you_go the length of each period), periods (pay_as_you_go: 1 to 12), price (US dollars such as "0.99": Apple picks its nearest price point at or above and the equal price in every country); promotional: name and code (what the app signs); winback: name, code (its offer ID), paidMonths, sinceMonths [min, max], startDate (YYYY-MM-DD), optional endDate, waitMonths, priority (high, normal); code: name, customers (new, existing, expired), stackWithIntro. A new intro replaces the one there, the free trial too, country by country: it answers with a job that ploa_product_job follows (offerId "intro" changes or ends it). Only a promotional offer's price and a win-back's dates, priority and months change later; offer codes only end. Google Play values: code (the offer ID: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens), phases (one or two: [{ duration such as P7D or P1M, periods, kind: free | discount | price, percent (1-99) or price }]; Play allows one paid phase, so two are a free one then a paid one), eligibility (new_app, new_subscription, upgrade with upgradeFrom another subscription's product ID or empty for another base plan of this one, developer: only when the app asks for it), tags. On a base plan already on sale a new offer goes on sale at once; otherwise with the plan. From an agent, a new offer, a price, phases or putting one on sale wait for a person's approval; ending and the rest go straight through.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

offerId.description: The offer to change or end; leave out to create.
